content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or prohibitively expensive, creators face severe obstacles in monetizing their [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-what-actually-how-3|COREMERCH guide to digital]] products. Countries across Africa and South America experience financial isolation, making it nearly impossible to sell ebooks, courses, or templates without incurring steep fees. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-nobody-tells-12|coremerch]] offers a robust infrastructure that eliminates excessive platform fees, allowing you to sell directly to your audience using cryptocurrency. This guide will walk you through the steps of deploying your own digital store, leveraging the full potential of crypto [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-broken-here-infrastructure-2|Payment Gateways]]s without the burden of traditional payment processors.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

Traditional platforms like Gumroad impose significant fees—up to 10% on each transaction—which can severely limit your profitability. In contrast, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, allowing you to retain more of your earnings. For example, if you sell a $97 product and make 100 sales in a month, the fee difference would save you $921. This infrastructure is designed for creators who refuse to be locked out by conventional services, offering direct access to payment processing and ownership of your revenue streams.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, gather the necessary tools. You will need a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, a Google account for Apps Script or Sheets, and a NOWPayments account for crypto transactions. Familiarize yourself with the basic functionalities of these platforms; they are all free to use. Understand the types of digital products you want to sell—be it ebooks, templates, or software—and prepare your files for upload. This foundational setup ensures a smooth deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, begin by configuring your NOWPayments account. Integrate it with your hosting platform to enable instant payment processing. Use Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to automate product delivery once payment is confirmed. This setup will allow you to store customer orders in Google Sheets or Supabase, automatically triggering file delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This streamlined process ensures that your customers receive their products instantly, enhancing the overall experience and increasing your sales potential.
Eliminate platform fees and keep more of your earnings.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it's time to go live. Publish your store and test the payment process with a small transaction. Make sure that the payment confirmation triggers the delivery pipeline correctly. Monitor the transaction flow to ensure that everything operates smoothly. This first transaction is critical; it validates your entire setup and helps you identify any potential issues. Once confirmed, you are ready to promote your store and start selling to a broader audience.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your initial sales, focus on scaling your infrastructure. Use the insights gleaned from your first transactions to optimize your product offerings and marketing strategies. Add more products to your store, utilizing the Complete Builder Kit ($197) which contains all six blueprints and seven templates to enhance your digital store's capabilities. Experiment with different marketing channels and leverage social media to reach more customers. This scalable approach will help you maximize your reach and revenue without being constrained by platform limitations.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automate delivery to enhance customer satisfaction instantly.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

Using crypto for digital sales reduces transaction fees significantly, offers instant payment confirmation, and allows you to operate without the need for traditional banking infrastructure.

You can set up your digital store within 48 hours using COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack, making it quick and efficient to start selling.
